data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit of GBP 12.0m in 2014 (2013, loss of GBP 27.4m) includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m (2013, GBP 4.4m deterioration).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported an explicit release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m (net) in 2014, which materially contributed to an underwriting profit of GBP 12.0m. This release represents approximately a 3.0% improvement relative to the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 (GBP 349.1m). The report does not disclose a gross (pre-reinsurance) prior-year movement figure in the technical reserves reconciliation, so the quoted GBP 10.6m appears to be a net (after reinsurance) release reported in the Managing Agent's commentary.
raw_causal_phrases: includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m (2013, GBP 4.4m deterioration).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The only explicit quantified prior-year movement in the report is a narrative statement of a GBP 10.6m release; the report does not present a separate GROSS (pre-reinsurance) 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is the reported net (after reinsurance) release and has been flagged accordingly. Gross written premium for 2014 is negative in the statutory segment (GBP 10.139m) as printed; segmental classes are taken verbatim from the segmental analysis note. No gross claims development triangle or per-LOB prior-year reserve movements were provided, so per-LOB prior year amounts are not available.
